rationale: The exact Agent Mode page names Platform 10.1.x+, general app 2.1.0+, 15 AWS AI service locations, and enabled Model Runtime. Its Cloud Connected instructions add 8089, scoped IP allowlisting and certificate/stack-address requirements. The Runtime guide lists separate AWS/Azure support, gives Dublin Global and Frankfurt Data zone, and describes possible third-party processing. The install guide and SAIA-9918 exclude Cloud Connected Enterprise for 2.2.0–2.3.6, with a 2.1.1 workaround lacking Agent Mode and 2.4.0 described as planned. Base-assistant install/IL2 and Cloud Connected data-use scope do not establish this feature’s routing, entitlement, authorization or usable Enterprise path.

exclusions: No native Cloud restriction, actual tenant availability, supported future release, entitlement or customer authorization is inferred.
